artifacts.name: HackerOne report #3618622: Claude Code bash-guard bypass via compound shell commands

verify.note: Submitted to Anthropic VDP (anthropic-vdp) on HackerOne on Mar 20, 2026. Reports that Claude Code's bash-guard PreToolUse hook does not split compound commands on shell operators (&&, ||, ;, |), allowing a deny rule for a standalone command (e.g. rm -rf) to be bypassed via chaining. Fix already written in PR #36645. Report ID: 3618622.
